A closer look at Earth Stories

What they're bringing

About Earth Stories

Earth Stories Cape Town is a slow-fashion, artisan brand built around handcrafted jewellery and consciously curated natural clothing. Pieces are made from sterling silver and gold-plated metal, often finished with ethically sourced elements like protea pods, brass and silver — delicate, story-infused designs meant to spark self-expression.

The clothing range runs alongside the jewellery, cut from breathable, sustainable cotton and rayon. Both are inspired by the raw beauty of Cape Town, with a thread of harmony, self-expression and mindful living running through the whole collection. Earth Stories is a regular at conscious markets and wellness gatherings across the Cape, from Spiritfest to Earthdance.
